itinerary.title: Journey to Ngorongoro Conservation Area
itinerary.activities: After an early breakfast, depart Moshi for the scenic drive to the world-renowned Ngorongoro Conservation Area. Pass through vibrant local villages and ascend the dramatic Great Rift Valley escarpment. Arrive at Ngorongoro Wild Camp in time for lunch, taking in panoramic vistas of the surrounding highlands. In the afternoon, embark on a scenic game drive along the crater rim and surrounding plateau, spotting zebra, wildebeest, and bird species before enjoying sunset over the caldera.

itinerary.title: Exploration of Ngorongoro Crater
itinerary.activities: Descend 600 meters down into the world’s largest intact volcanic caldera for a full-day wildlife extravaganza. The crater floor acts as a natural sanctuary hosting over 25,000 large mammals. Track the Big Five—lion, leopard, elephant, buffalo, and the critically endangered black rhino. Enjoy a picnic lunch beside the hippo pool at Ngoitoktok Springs while observing waterbirds and plains game grazing peacefully. In the late afternoon, ascend back to the crater rim and return to the camp for dinner and stargazing.

itinerary.title: Adventure in Lake Manyara National Park
itinerary.activities: Depart after breakfast towards Lake Manyara National Park, nestled beneath the cliffs of the Manyara Escarpment. Drive through the lush groundwater forest home to playful baboon troops and blue monkeys. Progress onto the open acacia woodlands and alkaline lakeshore, renowned for thousands of pink flamingos, pelicans, and large elephant herds. Keep your eyes peeled on the branches of majestic mahogany and acacia trees for Manyara’s legendary tree-climbing lions. In the late afternoon, drive back to Moshi for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.activities: Savor a leisurely breakfast at the hotel while taking in views of Mount Kilimanjaro. Depending on your flight schedule, our driver will transfer you to Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO) or Arusha Airport for your onward journey home or connection to Zanzibar for a tropical beach holiday.

itinerary.title: Tarangire National Park
itinerary.activities: After breakfast, depart for Tarangire National Park, celebrated for its colossal baobab trees and Tanzania’s highest concentration of African elephants. Game drive along the Tarangire River valley where herds of zebra, wildebeest, buffalo, giraffe, and waterbuck gather. In the late afternoon, proceed to Highview Hotel or Coffee Lodge for dinner and relaxation.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater
itinerary.activities: Rise early and travel to Ngorongoro Crater. Descend the 600m caldera walls onto the lush grassland floor. Witness dense populations of predators including lions, hyenas, and jackals hunting across the plains. Visit Lake Magadi for thousands of flamingos and search the Lerai forest for elusive leopards and black rhinos. Overnight near Karatu or Lake Eyasi.

itinerary.title: Hadzabe & Datoga Cultural Visit at Lake Eyasi
itinerary.activities: An unforgettable cultural day at Lake Eyasi. Join the indigenous Hadzabe bushmen on an authentic early morning hunting and foraging expedition, learning their traditional click-language and ancient survival techniques. Later, visit the Datoga pastoralists and blacksmiths who forge iron arrowheads and jewelry using traditional bellows. In the afternoon, return to your lodge for leisure.
itinerary.accommodation: Highview Hotel / Lake Eyasi Safari Lodge

itinerary.title: Lake Manyara National Park
itinerary.activities: Explore Lake Manyara National Park, famous for its underground springs, lush groundwater forest, and sprawling alkaline soda lake. itinerary.title: Springlands Hotel - Lemosho Park Gate - Mti Mkubwa Camp
itinerary.activities: On the first day, after breakfast and a briefing from your guide at Springlands Hotel, you’ll be transferred to Lemosho Park Gate (2,100m), a 1.5-hour drive. At Londorossi Gate, you’ll complete the registration before starting your trek along scenic forest trails to Mti Mkubwa Campsite (2750m), a 3-hour hike. Upon arrival, the porters will set up the tents and our chef will prepare lunch. After enjoying your meal, you’ll have time to relax until dinner.

itinerary.title: Mti Mkubwa Camp to Shira Camp 1
itinerary.activities: On the second day, you’ll start early with breakfast before embarking on a short hike from Mti Mkubwa to Shira 1 Camp, which typically takes up to 5 hours. As you trek, you’ll be treated to views of the west face of Kibo Volcano. The trail traverses lower moonland, showcasing large shrubs and vibrant wildflowers. Upon arrival at Shira 1 Camp, our porters will set up your tents while our chef prepares lunch.

itinerary.title: Shira Camp 1 to Shira Camp 2
itinerary.activities: On the third day, you will wake up early for breakfast and commence the brief hike from Shira 1 to Shira 2 camp. This usually takes no more than 5-6 hours. The trek is relatively easy, allowing you to relish breathtaking views of Africa. Upon reaching the Shira 2 campsite, our dedicated porters will take care of all the arrangements, such as pitching tents, while our chef prepares your lunch.

itinerary.title: Shira Camp 2 - Lava Tower - Barranco Camp

itinerary.title: Arrival
itinerary.activities: As you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport, our dedicated driver will be eagerly anticipating your arrival at the airport holding a sign with your name on it, ready to extend a warm and heartfelt welcome. From there, a seamless and comfortable transfer service will whisk you away to our enchanting Springlands Hotel. Upon arrival at the hotel, you will be served a delicious meal. Later on, our experienced mountain coordinators and your Guide will give you a pre-trekking briefing, an exciting opportunity to learn about the wonders that await you in your upcoming expedition.

itinerary.title: Moshi to Machame Camp
itinerary.activities: After breakfast and a briefing at your hotel, you’ll embark on a 45-minute drive from Moshi to Machame Park Gate. Upon arrival, you’ll complete the registration process and receive your lunch pack. The trek begins as you enter the lush rainforest, where you may encounter muddy and slippery conditions if it has rained. The trail to Machame Camp covers approximately 11 km and typically takes about 6 hours to complete. In the evening, the porters will boil drinking and washing water, while the cook prepares your dinner. With temperatures potentially dropping to freezing, you’ll retire to your tent for a chilly but rewarding night.

itinerary.title: Machame Camp to Shira Camp
itinerary.activities: After breakfast at Machame Camp, you’ll start your trek towards Shira Camp. The hike covers a distance of approximately 5 km and takes around 4 to 5 hours. The trail begins with a steep ascent through the moorland zone, offering stunning views as you climb. As you approach Shira Camp, you’ll be walking along a ridge with breathtaking vistas of the surrounding landscape. Upon arrival at Shira Camp, our porters will set up the tents and prepare lunch. You’ll have time to relax and acclimate before dinner. In the evening, your guide will brief you on the plans for the next day’s trek.

itinerary.title: Shira Camp to Lava Tower to Barranco Camp
itinerary.activities: After breakfast at Shira Camp, you’ll embark on a challenging trek to Lava Tower, reaching 4,630 meters. The 11 km hike takes 7 to 8 hours and features rocky, semi-desert terrain. Enjoy lunch with panoramic views at Lava Tower before descending to Barranco Camp at 3,960 meters. The descent, lasting about 2 hours, offers stunning vistas of the Western Breach. Upon arrival at Barranco Camp, the team will set up your tents and prepare dinner. Your guide will brief you on the next day’s trek in the evening, preparing you for the adventures ahead.

itinerary.title: Barranco Camp to Barafu Camp
itinerary.activities: After an early breakfast, you’ll begin the day by tackling the famous Barranco Wall, a steep yet rewarding climb that offers incredible views. Once at the top, you’ll descend into the lush Karanga Valley, where you’ll have lunch at the Karanga Camp. After a short rest, you’ll continue your trek toward Barafu Camp, climbing through varied terrain and stunning landscapes. Upon arrival at Barafu, the porters will set up camp while you rest and enjoy dinner prepared by our chef. In the evening, your guide will brief you on the upcoming summit attempt. Rest well, as the final ascent starts later in the night.

itinerary.title: Barafu Camp to Summit to Mweka Camp
itinerary.activities: You’ll rise around 11:30 PM and start the ascent after some tea and biscuits. Heading northwest, you’ll climb through scree towards Stella Point on the crater rim. The 6-hour trek to Stella Point (5685m) is often the most mentally and physically challenging part of the climb. After a brief rest at Stella Point, you’ll be rewarded with a magnificent sunrise, weather permitting. From there, it’s a 2-hour snow-covered ascent to Uhuru Peak. Your time at the summit will depend on the weather, so don’t linger too long due to the cold and fatigue. The descent to Barafu takes about 3 hours for a short rest before continuing to Mweka Camp for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Mweka Camp to Mweka Gate
itinerary.activities: After breakfast at Mweka Camp, you’ll descend to Mweka Gate and be driven back to Springlands Hotel, where a hot lunch and refreshing shower awaits. At the end of the trip, tipping the team is encouraged and appreciated; special envelopes for this purpose are available at the hotel. If you wish to extend your adventure with a safari, you can meet with our safari coordinator at the hotel. After some rest, the coordinator will provide a briefing on the various safari options available. We highly recommend booking a safari with us to experience Tanzania’s stunning wildlife and natural beauty, making your journey truly unforgettable.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.activities: After breakfast, you’ll be transferred back to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your departure. If you wish to extend your adventure, you may choose to add a day trip to your itinerary, exploring nearby attractions or immersing yourself in local culture. For more details, we invite you to visit our Day Trip page. Alternatively, you can continue your journey with a visit to the stunning island of Zanzibar. itinerary.title: Moir Hut | Pofu Camp
itinerary.activities: Start your trek with breakfast at Moir Hut, then proceed out of the moorland and into the alpine desert. Ascend a steep ridge off the main trail, a climb that will take about 5 to 7 hours to reach Pofu Camp (4,025 m). As you trek, enjoy the magnificent views of Kenya’s wild lands to the north. This challenging section of the journey offers a dramatic contrast to the lush moorland previously experienced, highlighting the stark beauty and vast expanse of the alpine desert. Arriving at Pofu Camp, you’ll have the opportunity to take in these breathtaking landscapes and prepare for the next stages of your adventure.

itinerary.title: Pofu Camp | Third Caves Camp
itinerary.activities: Begin your trek from Pofu Camp with a hearty breakfast, then continue eastward through valleys and ridges in the alpine desert and moorland. This trek, which takes approximately 5 to 7 hours, rewards you with expansive views of the vast mountain wilderness. As you progress, the rugged terrain and panoramic vistas offer a dramatic backdrop to your journey. Upon arrival at Third Caves Camp (3,600 m), you’ll have ample time to rest and acclimate, soaking in the serene surroundings. Enjoy the tranquil atmosphere as you prepare for the next day’s adventure, and savor a well-deserved dinner amidst the stunning landscapes.

itinerary.title: Third Caves Camp to Mawenzi Tarn Camp
itinerary.activities: Trek steadily upward to Mawenzi Tarn Camp, situated at an altitude of 4,315 meters, nestled at the base of the steep and dramatic ridges of Mawenzi, Kilimanjaro’s second highest peak. This segment of the trek takes you through rugged terrain, and as you climb, the landscape becomes increasingly majestic. Upon arrival at Mawenzi Tarn Camp, you’ll be greeted by breathtaking views of the surrounding peaks and the tranquil tarn that adds to the camp’s serene atmosphere. The peaceful setting provides a perfect backdrop for relaxation and acclimatization, allowing you to fully appreciate the grandeur of your surroundings and prepare for the next leg of your journey.

itinerary.title: Mawenzi Tarn Hut to Kibo Hut
itinerary.activities: After breakfast, you’ll embark on a trek across the vast, barren lunar landscape known as the “Saddle,” which stretches between Mawenzi and Kibo peaks. The terrain is desolate yet mesmerizing, with rugged vistas and the summit looming ahead in the distance. Though the trail is long, it maintains a gentle incline, allowing for a steady pace as you approach the final stage of your journey. Upon arriving at Kibo Hut, you’ll rest and enjoy an early dinner to conserve energy for the summit attempt. Your guide will provide a detailed briefing, as the ascent to Uhuru Peak begins shortly after midnight.

itinerary.title: Kibo Camp | Uhuru Peak | Millennium Camp
itinerary.activities: Wake up around midnight to start your summit trek. Begin hiking at 1 am, navigating switchbacks and loose rock as you ascend to Gillman’s Point (5,685 m). From there, continue to Uhuru Peak (5,895 m), where you can enjoy breathtaking views and spend a brief time at the summit. After taking in the magnificent scenery, descend to Millennium Camp (3,110 m) to rest for the night. The challenging climb to the summit and subsequent descent will be both physically demanding and rewarding, making the evening’s rest at Millennium Camp a well-deserved reprieve.

itinerary.title: Millennium Camp | Mweka Gate
itinerary.activities: Descend from Millennium Camp (3,110 m) to Mweka Gate (1,830 m) in approximately 2 to 3 hours. Once at the gate, you’ll receive your climbing certificate to commemorate your achievement. Afterward, you’ll be transferred back to Springlands Hotel for your overnight stay. Enjoy a relaxing evening at the hotel, reflecting on your incredible journey and the accomplishment of your climb. If you have booked a safari, our safari coordinator will meet with you in the afternoon to provide a pre-briefing and discuss your upcoming adventure.

itinerary.title: Departure Day

The adventure begins with your ascent through the vibrant rainforest, where the path may become muddy and slick if there has been recent rainfall. The trek to Machame Camp spans roughly 11 kilometers and usually takes around six hours. In the evening, porters will prepare hot water for drinking and washing, while the cook will serve up dinner. You’ll have the afternoon to relax and acclimate to the altitude before dinner, followed by a briefing from your guide on the next day’s trek.

itinerary.title: Shira Camp to Lava Tower to Barranco Camp

This descent lasts about 2 hours and offers stunning vistas of the Western Breach. Upon reaching Barranco Camp, the team will set up your tents and prepare dinner for you. Once you’ve conquered the Wall, you’ll make your way down into the picturesque Karanga Valley, celebrated for its lush greenery and stunning views. Upon arrival at the Karanga campsite, the porters will set up your tents while our chef prepares a delicious lunch. After your meal, you’ll undertake an acclimatization hike toward Barafu Camp, gaining an elevation of 200 meters before returning to your campsite. In the evening, savor a warm dinner crafted by our chef. Following your meal, your knowledgeable guide will provide a briefing on the next day’s trek, outlining the route, anticipated challenges, and essential details to help you prepare.

itinerary.title: Karanga Camp | Barafu Camp
itinerary.activities: Begin your day with an early wake-up call and a substantial breakfast to prepare for your trek to Barafu campsite. As you ascend, prioritize acclimatization to prevent altitude sickness. Upon your arrival at Barafu, our porters will take care of setting up the camp while the chef prepares a nourishing lunch. After your meal, take some time to relax until dinner. In the evening, your guide will provide a detailed briefing regarding the forthcoming summit attempt, discussing the route, potential challenges, safety protocols, and necessary preparations. Be sure to rest well, as the summit ascent is scheduled to begin late in the evening.

itinerary.activities: You’ll begin your ascent around 11:30 PM, starting with some tea and biscuits to fuel your energy. This 6-hour trek to Stella Point (5,685 meters) is often considered the most mentally and physically demanding section of the climb. Once you reach Stella Point, take a moment to enjoy the breathtaking sunrise, conditions permitting. From there, you’ll continue on a snow-covered path for an additional 2-hour climb to Uhuru Peak. Be mindful of your time at the summit, as weather conditions may dictate the duration of your stay. It’s essential not to linger too long due to the cold and the fatigue you’ll experience. The descent to Barafu takes approximately 3 hours, where you’ll have a brief rest before continuing to Mweka Camp for dinner and your overnight stay.

After your journey, tipping the team is encouraged and appreciated; special envelopes for this purpose will be available at the hotel. If you’re interested in extending your adventure with a safari, you can meet with our safari coordinator at the hotel. After a short break to relax, the coordinator will provide a briefing on the various Tanzania safari options available. We highly recommend booking a safari with us to fully experience Tanzania’s breathtaking wildlife and natural beauty, ensuring your journey is truly unforgettable.
